title: Risk of Vaping Progressing to Drug Abuse and Classifying Vapes under Section 9 of Misuse of Drugs Act to Prevent Abuse
what_it_is: Risk of Vaping Progressing to Drug Abuse and Classifying Vapes under Section 9 of Misuse of Drugs Act to Prevent Abuse

sections.label: Vapes used for controlled drugs
sections.summary: HSA and CNB have found cases of persons using vapes to consume controlled drugs.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The Health Sciences Authority (HSA) and the Central Narcotics Bureau (CNB) have come across some cases of persons using vapes to consume controlled drugs.

sections.label: Vape drug offences under MDA
sections.summary: Trafficking, possession and consumption of controlled drugs using vapes are offences under the Misuse of Drugs Act, including possession of apparatus under section 9.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The trafficking, possession and consumption of controlled drugs using vapes are already offences under the Misuse of Drugs Act (MDA).

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The possession of any apparatus or article, including vapes, for the consumption of controlled drugs, is an offence under section 9 of the MDA.

sections.label: Inter-Ministry committee on youth drug prevention
sections.summary: An inter-Ministry committee on drug prevention for youths was formed to work with agencies upstream so young people know what to do about drugs.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Recently, we formed an inter-Ministry committee (IMC) on drug prevention for youths, where we work with the different agencies to go upstream so that our young people and our society not only are aware but know what to do when they come across issues or physically coming across drugs.

sections.label: Cannabis and synthetic drugs in vapes
sections.summary: Cannabis and synthetic drugs are the main common drugs used in vapes, and the numbers at this moment are small.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: For types of drugs, we have found cannabis and synthetic drugs.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: These are the main common drugs used in vapes.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: With regard to the numbers, like what I shared earlier, at this moment, it is small.

sections.label: Programmes for youths on drug harms
sections.summary: Programmes and the IMC work with agencies and community partners to share with youths the harms of drugs and pro-social activities.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We understand that these are the trends that youths are facing and that are coming into their mind.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, we have programmes and the IMC, which I have shared earlier, to see how, at the various fronts with the agencies as well as community partners, we can go upstream to share with youths the harms of drugs and what kind of pro-social activities and groups they can join to see how they can turn their lives towards positive avenues.

sections.label: Not waiting on drug issue
sections.summary: The speaker states that they are not waiting.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: As I shared earlier, we are not waiting.

sections.label: CNB drug enforcement cooperation
sections.summary: CNB colleagues work hard with agencies and counterparts to detect, block and strictly enforce against drug syndicates harming people.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: At the end of the day, it is about how we can work together with the agencies and how we work together with our counterparts.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: And, as Members know, it is not easy to detect, but our CNB colleagues have worked very hard and they will continue to work hard to make sure that as much as we can, we will protect our shores, as much as the syndicates want to bring in, we also want to work hard to ensure that it does not come in.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: But if it comes in, we will take strict enforcement and we want to make sure that we disrupt as many syndicates or efforts to harm our people, as much as possible.
